name: PawnPass Agent
description: AI agent for PawnPass, Australia's first digital pawnbroker. Can answer questions about pawn loans, check eligibility, quote pricing, and initiate loan applications.

capabilities.name: answer_questions
capabilities.description: Answer questions about PawnPass services, rates, accepted items, process, and policies using the knowledge catalog.

capabilities.name: check_eligibility
capabilities.description: Check if a customer is eligible for a pawn loan or buy outright. Requires: age 18+, owns item outright, valid Australian ID, Australian bank account.

capabilities.name: quote_pricing
capabilities.description: Get an instant AI-powered valuation for an item. Submit category, brand, model, condition, and photos to receive loan amount, buy amount, and interest rate.

request_schema.category: string (required) — one of: jewellery-gold, watches, phones, laptops, tablets, gaming, tools, cameras, other
request_schema.condition: string (required) — one of: new, excellent, good, fair, poor

capabilities.name: initiate_application
capabilities.description: Redirect customer to the online application flow. The full flow includes: quote → ID verification → shipping → payment.

capabilities.name: find_shipping_options
capabilities.description: Find nearby Australia Post Parcel Lockers for item drop-off, or arrange home pickup.

request_schema.action: string — one of: find_lockers, create_shipment, track_shipment, get_label

authentication.description: Public read-only catalog and valuation API. Transactional endpoints (loans, shipping) require session authentication.

escalation.description: Complex queries, disputes, and valuation adjustments are escalated to human support via email (info@pawnpass.com.au) or phone (0439 726 576). Response target: within 24 hours.
